# RM brief — ECI 9 GP LIMITED (SC349083)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by SEC-07 — Negative pledge  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- ECI 9 GP LIMITED (SC349083) is an active Scottish private limited company incorporated on 25 September 2008, filing small accounts under SIC 64999 (other financial service activities). It has two active officers out of nine ever appointed, with one director appointed on 13 October 2025. `[profile; officers; computed]`
- Two charges are on record, both in favour of Silicon Valley Bank: one created 31 March 2015 (fixed and floating) and one created 20 May 2015 (floating). Both are recorded as fully satisfied, so the company currently has a clean security position and a first-charge facility could be considered subject to other policies. `[SC3490830001; SC3490830002; SEC-02; SEC-03]`
- Filing conduct is strong: accounts to 31 December 2025 were filed on 8 May 2026, 143 days ahead of the deadline, and the last accounts due on 30 September 2027 are not overdue. Only two late filings appear in the whole history (3 days late in 2016 and 21 days late in 2021). `[AA filed 2026-05-08; profile; AA filed 2016-10-01; AA filed 2021-10-19]`
- The accounts most recently filed were made up to 31 December 2025, roughly nine months before the 30 September 2026 review date, so the financial picture is reasonably current. `[computed; profile]`
- The case is a REFER because both Silicon Valley Bank charges contained a negative pledge, which bars creating a further charge over the same security without the existing lender's written consent. `[SEC-07; SC3490830001; SC3490830002]`
- Before any facility is offered, obtain written evidence of consent or confirmation that the negative pledge fell away on satisfaction of the charges; do not make an offer to the customer until that evidence is on file. `[SEC-07; SC3490830001; SC3490830002]`
